article.story: HONOLULU -- — Isaac Johnson's 25 points helped Hawaii defeat Manhattan 86-56 on Saturday. Johnson also added 11 rebounds for the Rainbow Warriors (3-1). Isaac Finlinson scored 14 points and added seven rebounds. Yacine Toumi shot 2 of 3 from the field and 6 of 8 from the free-throw line to finish with 10 points. The Jaspers (2-2) were led by Anthony Isaac, who posted 17 points. Quron Elliott added seven points for Manhattan. Devin Dinkins had six points and four assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
